fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Su pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que piensa salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: The passport's date of issue must be less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: La fecha de emisión del pasaporte debe ser de menos de 10 años antes de su llegada.
entry.quote: less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: At Polish border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo polaco puede que le pidan un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: At Polish border control you may need to prove that you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo polaco puede que le pidan demostrar que tiene dinero suficiente para su estancia.
entry.quote: prove that you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas puede que deba registrar datos biométricos, como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared.
entry.es: Debe declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

safety.en: Be alert to street crime and petty theft, as criminals view foreigners as easy targets.
safety.es: Esté atento a los delitos callejeros y los hurtos, ya que los delincuentes ven a los extranjeros como blancos fáciles.
safety.quote: Be alert to street crime and petty theft. Criminals view foreigners as easy targets.

safety.en: Unofficial taxi drivers often overcharge, and passengers have been attacked in unofficial taxis and in cars booked using ride share apps.
safety.es: Los taxistas no oficiales suelen cobrar de más, y se han producido agresiones a pasajeros en taxis no oficiales y en coches reservados con aplicaciones de viaje compartido.
safety.quote: Unofficial taxi drivers often overcharge. Passengers have been attacked, including sexual assaults, in unofficial taxis and cars booked using ride share apps.

safety.en: Victims of spiked drinks have been robbed in bars and clubs.
safety.es: Hay víctimas de bebidas adulteradas que han sido robadas en bares y discotecas.
safety.quote: Victims of spiked drinks have been robbed in bars and clubs.

safety.en: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public places.
safety.es: Es ilegal beber alcohol en lugares públicos.
safety.quote: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public places.

safety.en: You should always carry ID, and a printed copy of the passport photo page is acceptable.
safety.es: Debe llevar siempre un documento de identidad, y se acepta una copia impresa de la página de la foto del pasaporte.
safety.quote: Always carry ID. A printed copy of the photo page of your passport is acceptable.

safety.en: Some Russian military strikes in Ukraine have hit within 20km of the Polish border.
safety.es: Algunos ataques militares rusos en Ucrania han impactado a menos de 20 km de la frontera polaca.
safety.quote: Some Russian military strikes in Ukraine have hit within 20km of the Polish border.

health.es: Para pedir una ambulancia, llame al 112.
health.quote: Telephone 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Public medical facilities in Poland are similar to those in the UK, and private ones are less expensive than in the UK.
health.es: Los centros médicos públicos de Polonia son similares a los del Reino Unido y los privados son más baratos que allí.
health.quote: Public medical facilities in Poland are similar to those in the UK. Private medical facilities are less expensive than the UK.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink in all of Poland.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber en toda Polonia.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink in all of Poland.

health.en: Health risks in Poland include biting insects and ticks.
health.es: Entre los riesgos de salud en Polonia están los insectos que pican y las garrapatas.

health.en: Travellers should have travel insurance covering local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Los viajeros deben tener un seguro de viaje que cubra el tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

health.en: Poland has a serious smog problem because it relies heavily on coal and wood for home heating.
health.es: Polonia tiene un grave problema de smog porque depende mucho del carbón y la leña para la calefacción doméstica.
health.quote: Poland relies heavily on coal and wood for home heating, and thus has a serious smog problem

help.en: Emergency numbers are 999 for an ambulance, 998 for fire and 997 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 999 (ambulancia), 998 (bomberos) y 997 (policía).

help.en: The European emergency number 112 is being deployed and works for all mobile-phone calls and most land-line calls.
help.es: El número europeo de emergencias 112 se está implantando y funciona en todas las llamadas desde móvil y en la mayoría desde fijo.
help.quote: The European unified emergency number 112 is being deployed in Poland. By now, it certainly works for all mobile-phone calls and most land-line calls.

help.en: Municipal Guards, reached on 986, are an auxiliary police force found only in large cities.
help.es: La Guardia Municipal, al 986, es una fuerza auxiliar de policía que solo existe en las grandes ciudades.
help.quote: Municipal Guards (Straż Miejska), dial 986, is a kind of auxiliary Police force found only in large cities.

getting_in.en: Warsaw's Chopin Airport (WAW) remains the country's main international hub.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Chopin de Varsovia (WAW) sigue siendo el principal centro internacional del país.
getting_in.quote: Warsaw's Chopin Airport (WAW IATA) remains the country's main international hub.

getting_in.en: Modlin Airport (WMI), near Warsaw, is a converted former military airfield normally used by low-fare carriers.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Modlin (WMI), cerca de Varsovia, es un antiguo aeródromo militar que suelen usar las aerolíneas de bajo coste.
getting_in.quote: Modlin Airport (WMI IATA), a converted former military airfield, is close to Warsaw and normally used by low-fare carriers.

getting_in.en: Trains cross into Poland from Germany, the Czech Republic and Slovakia with no formalities because all are Schengen countries.
getting_in.es: Los trenes cruzan a Polonia desde Alemania, Chequia y Eslovaquia sin trámites porque todos son países Schengen.
getting_in.quote: trains rattle across the border from Germany, Czech Republic and Slovakia, with no formalities as these are all Schengen countries.

getting_in.en: Queues at borders with non-EU neighbours Ukraine, Belarus and Russia are long and can take up to several hours in areas congested with truck traffic.
getting_in.es: Las colas en las fronteras con Ucrania, Bielorrusia y Rusia, vecinos no pertenecientes a la UE, son largas y pueden llevar varias horas donde hay mucho tráfico de camiones.
getting_in.quote: the queues on the borders with Poland's non-EU neighbours, Ukraine, Belarus and Russia, are still long and in areas congested with truck traffic it can take up to several hours to pass.

getting_in.en: The principal long-distance bus operator to Poland is Flixbus.
getting_in.es: El principal operador de autobuses de larga distancia hacia Polonia es Flixbus.
getting_in.quote: The principal long-distance bus operator to Poland is Flixbus.

getting_in.en: Ferries from Sweden include Ystad (7-9 hours, 215 zł) by Unity Line and Karlskrona (10 hours, 140-220 zł) by Stena Line.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris desde Suecia, como Ystad (7-9 horas, 215 zł) con Unity Line y Karlskrona (10 horas, 140-220 zł) con Stena Line.
getting_in.quote: From Sweden: Ystad (7–9 hours, 215 zł) by Unity Line; Karlskrona (10 hours, 140-220 zł) by Stena Line

getting_around.en: Public transport is plentiful and inexpensive, with buses and trams in cities and charter buses and trains for long distances.
getting_around.es: El transporte público es abundante y barato, con autobuses y tranvías en las ciudades y autobuses de línea y trenes para largas distancias.
getting_around.quote: public transport is quite plentiful and inexpensive: buses and trams in cities, and charter buses and trains for long-distance travel.

getting_around.en: Warsaw-Kraków (every two hours) and Warsaw-Gdansk (hourly) trains both take under 3 hours.
getting_around.es: Los trenes Varsovia-Cracovia (cada dos horas) y Varsovia-Gdansk (cada hora) tardan menos de 3 horas.
getting_around.quote: Warsaw-Kraków (every two hours) and Warsaw-Gdansk (hourly) both take under 3 hours.

getting_around.en: Booking Intercity trains early (7 or 15 days before departure) is rewarded with an additional discount of 20 or 30%.
getting_around.es: Reservar con antelación los trenes Intercity (7 o 15 días antes) da un descuento adicional del 20 o el 30 %.
getting_around.quote: An early booking of the Intercity trains (7/15 days before departure) will be rewarded with additional discount (20/30%).

getting_around.en: Tickets for E-IC, EC and EXpress trains are not valid for local or regional trains on the same routes.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de trenes E-IC, EC y EXpress no valen para los trenes locales o regionales de las mismas rutas.
getting_around.quote: Tickets bought for E-IC, EC, EXpress, etc. trains are not valid for local/regional trains on the same routes.

getting_around.en: Private charter bus companies tend to be cheaper, faster and more comfortable than rail.
getting_around.es: Las empresas privadas de autobuses suelen ser más baratas, rápidas y cómodas que el tren.
getting_around.quote: Poland has a very well developed network of private charter bus companies, which tend to be cheaper, faster, and more comfortable than travel by rail.

getting_around.en: Public transport tickets must be validated at the start of the journey, or inspectors will fine you.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de transporte público deben validarse al inicio del viaje; si no, los inspectores multan.
getting_around.quote: Validate your public transport ticket at the start of the journey. You will get a fine if inspectors find you travelling on an invalid or unvalidated ticket.

money.en: The legal tender in Poland is the Polish złoty (PLN).
money.es: La moneda de curso legal en Polonia es el esloti polaco (PLN).
money.quote: The legal tender in Poland is the Polish złoty, pronounced zwoty.

money.en: Credit and debit cards can be used to pay almost everywhere in the big cities.
money.es: Se puede pagar con tarjeta de crédito o débito casi en todas partes en las grandes ciudades.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards can be used to pay almost everywhere in the big cities.

money.en: There is an extensive network of ATMs, called bankomat.
money.es: Hay una extensa red de cajeros automáticos, llamados bankomat.
money.quote: There is an extensive network of cash machines or ATMs (Polish: bankomat).

money.en: When an ATM offers currency conversion, decline it because of the big markup fee.
money.es: Si un cajero ofrece conversión de divisa, recházela por el elevado recargo.
money.quote: Decline the currency conversion as there is a big markup fee.

money.en: The average tip is around 10% of the price, and it is polite but not uncommon to skip it.
money.es: La propina media ronda el 10 % del precio; es de buena educación, pero no es raro omitirla.
money.quote: The average tip is around 10% of the price. It's polite to leave a tip, but it's not uncommon to ignore this practice.

money.en: Currency exchange offices in tourist hot-spots such as train stations tend to overcharge.
money.es: Las casas de cambio en zonas turísticas, como las estaciones de tren, tienden a cobrar de más.
money.quote: Exchanges in tourist hot-spots, such as the train stations or popular tourist destinations, tend to overcharge.

etiquette.en: When visiting someone's home, it is polite to ask whether you should take off your shoes.
etiquette.es: Al visitar una casa, es de buena educación preguntar si debe quitarse los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: When visiting someone's home, it's polite to ask if you should take off your shoes.

etiquette.en: Flower bouquets should have an odd number of flowers, since even-numbered ones are reserved for funerals and anniversaries.
etiquette.es: Los ramos de flores deben tener un número impar de flores, ya que los pares se reservan para funerales y aniversarios.
etiquette.quote: just remember to buy odd number, even-numbered flower bouquets are reserved for funerals and anniversaries.

etiquette.en: Men should not wear hats indoors, in particular when entering a church.
etiquette.es: Los hombres no deben llevar sombrero en interiores, sobre todo al entrar en una iglesia.
etiquette.quote: Men should not wear hats indoors, in particular when entering a church

etiquette.en: Shaking hands while wearing gloves is considered insincere and rude.
etiquette.es: Dar la mano con guantes puestos se considera insincero y descortés.
etiquette.quote: Do not ever handshake in gloves, it is considered insincere and rude.

etiquette.en: Displaying Soviet or communist symbols is illegal in Poland, except in the grounds of World War II cemeteries.
etiquette.es: Exhibir símbolos soviéticos o comunistas es ilegal en Polonia, salvo en los recintos de cementerios de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
etiquette.quote: The display of Soviet or communist symbols is illegal in Poland, with the exception of those located in the grounds of World War II cemeteries.

etiquette.en: Using former German names for Polish places may cause confusion and may be regarded as offensive.
etiquette.es: Usar los antiguos nombres alemanes de lugares polacos puede causar confusión y ser considerado ofensivo.
etiquette.quote: Calling Polish towns and places by their (former) German names, when asking for directions (e.g. referring to Breslau instead of Wrocław) may cause confusion and may be regarded as intentionally offensive and disrespectful by the Polish people.

connectivity.en: Prepaid starter SIM kits (pakiety startowe) are widely available in most shops, supermarkets and news agents for 5-20 zł.
connectivity.es: Los kits de SIM de prepago (pakiety startowe) se venden en la mayoría de tiendas, supermercados y quioscos por 5-20 zł.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid starter kits with SIM card (called pakiety startowe) are widely available for reasonable prices (5–20 zł) in most shops, supermarkets and news agents.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards must be registered with an ID card or passport to operate.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM de prepago deben registrarse con un documento de identidad o pasaporte para funcionar.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid SIM cards must be registered with an ID card or passport to operate.

connectivity.en: With an EU-based mobile subscription, you should be able to use at least some bundled minutes, SMS and data in Poland at no extra cost.
connectivity.es: Con un contrato móvil de un operador de la UE, debería poder usar al menos parte de los minutos, SMS y datos incluidos en Polonia sin coste adicional.
connectivity.quote: If you have an existing subscription with an EU-based mobile provider, you should be able to use at least some of your bundled minutes, SMS, and data in Poland at no extra cost.

connectivity.en: Plus, T-Mobile, Orange and Play are the most popular mobile operators in Poland.
connectivity.es: Plus, T-Mobile, Orange y Play son los operadores móviles más populares de Polonia.
connectivity.quote: There are numerous mobile phone operators in Poland: Plus, T-Mobile, Orange and Play are the most popular ones

connectivity.en: Most coffee shops and restaurants have Wi-Fi for customers, usually password-protected.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de cafeterías y restaurantes ofrecen wifi a los clientes, normalmente con contraseña.
connectivity.quote: Most coffee shops and restaurants have Wi-Fi available for customers – usually password-protected.

connectivity.en: LTE is available in every town, and 5G was being implemented as of 2021.
connectivity.es: Hay LTE en todas las ciudades, y el 5G se estaba implantando en 2021.
connectivity.quote: LTE is available in every town and 5G is being implemented as of 2021.
